brewing.notes: A safe starting point for black tea: Western style, water just off the boil.

description:
A local black tea from southwestern Anhui, made from regional leaf using black tea methods.

Treat it as you would any black tea: water just off the boil, a few minutes in the pot, and a seller who can say where it was grown.
history: Tea merchants in southwestern Anhui make it as a local alternative to the province's far better known Keemun. Little more is documented.
processing: Typical of black tea: withered, rolled, fully oxidised and dried.
harvest_season: Picked through the growing season, as with most black teas.
appearance_dry: Usually dark twisted leaf, sometimes with golden tips.
taste_profile: Expect what black teas usually give: malty, sweet and brisk.
vintage_note: Black teas are normally sold by harvest year and are best within a couple of years.
